articles.title: Who Is Nithya Raman? The Kerala-Born Urban Planner Who Just Became Los Angeles' First Indian-American Mayor
articles.excerpt: Born in Thrissur, raised between Kerala and Massachusetts, trained at Harvard and MIT, Nithya Raman mapped Chennai's missing services, organised Los Angeles neighbours around homelessness, unseated two incumbents six years apart — and on December 14 becomes the first Asian American, Indian American and Hindu mayor of America's second-largest city.
articles.image_caption: Nithya Raman in her official portrait as a member of the Los Angeles City Council. The Kerala-born urban planner, first elected to the council in 2020, defeated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass on November 3, 2026 to become the city's first Indian-American mayor.
articles.nri_angle: The Thrissur-born, Harvard- and MIT-educated planner's defeat of incumbent Karen Bass makes her Los Angeles' first Indian-American mayor — and, with Zohran Mamdani in New York, puts South Asian Americans in charge of America's two largest cities.
